key_insight: TextSeal2 embeds detectable watermarks in LLM-generated text without changing the model’s output distribution. Its watermark survives speculative decoding, including tokens that replace rejected drafts, without reducing draft acceptance rates.
problem_solved: LLM watermarking must preserve output diversity and generation speed while remaining detectable during speculative decoding. The provided abstract also identifies a limitation in TextSeal’s coin-flip routing between two watermark keys.
method: Uses copula mixing and memoryless races, as indicated by the title, to construct a distortion-free watermark.
Keeps replacement tokens watermarked with the same keys when speculative drafts are rejected.
Preserves output diversity and speculative-decoding acceptance rates, with no measurable added inference latency reported.
impact: TextSeal2 could help practitioners identify AI-generated text without sacrificing sampling behavior or speculative-decoding speed. The supplied abstract is truncated, so implementation details and quantitative results cannot be assessed here.
visual_elements: Speculative-decoding flowchart showing accepted drafts and watermarked replacement tokens.
Two-key routing diagram contrasting TextSeal’s coin flip with TextSeal2’s copula-mixing approach.
Conceptual before-and-after token-distribution chart illustrating distortion-free sampling.
Three-icon panel highlighting preserved diversity, unchanged acceptance rate, and no measurable added latency.
paper_title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
paper_authors: Tom Sander, Pierre Fernandez, Itai Gat, Haiming Bao, Jiaxin Shi
